name: Dusklight Manor
source:
You are a young man that was offered a great opportunity for a new job and you decide to take it. You arrive at the Dusklight Manor to begin your new life and work, here you meet four wonderful girls that are under the tutelage of Mistress Clara, an enigmatic figure with more secrets than you can imagine.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/StrandedWithBenefits]Patreon[/url]]
